facts.value: While on STEM OPT, you are limited in the information that you can update in the SEVP Portal. Employment updates must be submitted through the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm in the MyISSC eForm portal.
When reporting changes in employment, a new I-983 may be required.
You will be required to upload a completed I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation when ending a job.
You will be required to upload a completed I-983 (pgs. 1-4) when starting a new job or adding an additional job.
Changes in employer name, EIN, employer address, working location, hours, compensation, job responsibilities, or training plan/learning objectives require an updated I-983.
If your supervisor changes and the new supervisor will continue with the same training plan and your job responsibilities will not change, an updated I-983 is not required.
If the change in job title does not impact your main job responsibilities and/or the training plan, an updated I-983 is not required.
Students may have multiple jobs while on STEM OPT, provided all conditions of the STEM OPT employment criteria are met.
Each job must be related to your major area of study, require at least 20 hours a week, be with a company that participates in E-Verify, and must be a paid position.
